summary.text: Amiel Goldberg is the Democratic candidate for Connecticut House of Representatives District 149 in the November 3, 2026 general election, against incumbent Tina Courpas (R).
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has served for five years on Stamford's Board of Representatives and has a background in financial risk management.

paragraphs.text: Amiel Goldberg said in a Ballotpedia survey that his career in financial risk management included roles as a Treasury Executive at BNY Mellon, Executive Consultant at IBM Global Business Services, Chief Risk Officer at GE Asset Management, and Investment Banker at UBS Stamford.
He said he is married to Kirsten Hohmann, an internist, and that they have two daughters who graduated from the Academy of Information Technology and Engineering in Stamford.
Goldberg described himself in the survey as a lifelong Democrat and a voice for the sensible center.
He said that on the Stamford Board of Representatives he worked with other members and the mayor to pass balanced budgets and made sure property tax increases did not exceed the rate of inflation.
Goldberg named affordability as his top issue and said he is also passionate about health care and education, including state support for special education funding.
